segments.source: Creating custom audio effects
segments.ko: 사용자 지정 오디오 효과 만들기

segments.source: **Framework**: AVFAudio
segments.ko: **Framework**: AVFAudio

segments.source: Add custom audio-effect processing to apps like Logic Pro X and GarageBand by creating Audio Unit (AU) plug-ins.
segments.ko: Audio Unit (AU) 플러그인을 생성해 Logic Pro X 및 GarageBand와 같은 앱에 사용자 지정 오디오 효과 처리를 추가합니다.

segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.ko: iPadOS 17.0+

segments.source: Mac Catalyst 17.0+
segments.ko: Mac Catalyst 17.0+

segments.ko: macOS 14.0+

segments.ko: Xcode 15.4+

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: This sample app shows you how to create a custom audio effect plug-in using the latest Audio Unit standard (AUv3).
segments.ko: 이 샘플 앱은 최신 Audio Unit 표준(AUv3)을 사용해 사용자 지정 오디오 효과 플러그인을 만드는 방법을 보여줍니다.

segments.source: The AUv3 standard builds on the [`App Extensions`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/General/Conceptual/ExtensibilityPG) model, which means you deliver your plug-in as an extension that’s contained in an app distributed through the App Store or your own store.
segments.ko: AUv3 표준은 [`App Extensions`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/General/Conceptual/ExtensibilityPG) 모델을 기반으로 하며, 플러그인을 App Store 또는 자체 스토어를 통해 배포되는 앱에 포함된 확장으로 제공한다는 의미입니다.

segments.source: The sample Audio Unit is a low-pass filter that allows frequencies at or below the cutoff frequency to pass through to the output.
segments.ko: 샘플 Audio Unit은 컷오프 주파수 이하의 주파수를 출력으로 통과시키는 저역 통과 필터입니다.

segments.source: It attenuates frequencies above this point.
segments.ko: 이 지점 이상의 주파수는 감쇠됩니다.

segments.source: It also lets you change the filter’s resonance, which boosts or attenuates a narrow band of frequencies around the cutoff point.
segments.ko: 또한 컷오프 지점 주변의 좁은 대역을 부스트하거나 감쇠하는 필터 공진도 조절도 가능합니다.

segments.source: You set these values by moving the draggable point around the plug-in’s user interface, as shown in the figure below.
segments.ko: 아래 그림에서처럼, 플러그인의 사용자 인터페이스에 있는 드래그 가능한 점을 이동해 이러한 값을 설정합니다.

segments.source: ![plug-in User Interface](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/77036aca41724e5409050b93ab4a5b9c/graph.png)
segments.ko: ![plug-in User Interface](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/77036aca41724e5409050b93ab4a5b9c/graph.png)

segments.source: The project has targets for both iOS and macOS.
segments.ko: 이 프로젝트에는 iOS와 macOS 대상이 모두 있습니다.

segments.source: Each platform’s main app target has two supporting targets: `AUv3FilterExtension`, which contains the plug-in packaged as an Audio Unit extension, and `AUv3FilterFramework`, which bundles the plug-in’s code and resources.
segments.ko: 각 플랫폼의 기본 앱 대상에는 두 개의 지원 대상이 있습니다. `AUv3FilterExtension`은 플러그인을 Audio Unit 확장으로 패키징한 대상이고, `AUv3FilterFramework`는 플러그인의 코드와 리소스를 번들로 묶는 대상입니다.

segments.source: **Note**: See [`Incorporating Audio Effects and Instruments`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/incorporating-audio-effects-and-instruments) for details on how you can use this Audio Unit extension in a host app.
segments.ko: **참고**: 이 Audio Unit 확장을 호스트 앱에서 사용하는 방법은 [`Incorporating Audio Effects and Instruments`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/incorporating-audio-effects-and-instruments)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Create a Custom Audio Effect Plug in
segments.ko: 사용자 지정 오디오 효과 플러그인 생성

segments.source: The extension itself contains two primary pieces: an Audio Unit proper and a factory object that creates it.
segments.ko: 확장 자체에는 두 가지 주요 구성 요소가 있습니다. 하나는 Audio Unit 본체이고, 다른 하나는 이를 생성하는 factory 객체입니다.

segments.source: The sample app’s Audio Unit is `AUv3FilterDemo`.
segments.ko: 샘플 앱의 Audio Unit은 `AUv3FilterDemo`입니다.

segments.source: This is a Swift class that subclasses [`AUAudioUnit`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit) and defines the plug-in’s interface, including key features like its parameters, presets, and I/O busses.
segments.ko: 이 클래스는 [`AUAudioUnit`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit)을 상속하는 Swift class이며, 매개변수, 프리셋, I/O 버스 같은 핵심 기능을 포함해 플러그인의 인터페이스를 정의합니다.

segments.source: A class called `FilterDSPKernel` provides the plug-in’s digital signal processing (DSP) logic, and is written in C++ to ensure real-time safety.
segments.ko: `FilterDSPKernel`이라는 클래스가 플러그인의 디지털 신호 처리(DSP) 로직을 제공하며, 실시간 안전성을 보장하기 위해 C++로 작성됩니다.

segments.source: Because Swift can’t talk directly to C++, the sample project also includes an Objective-C++ adapter class called `FilterDSPKernelAdapter` to act as an intermediary.
segments.ko: Swift가 C++와 직접 통신할 수 없기 때문에 샘플 프로젝트에는 중간 역할을 하는 Objective-C++ 어댑터 클래스 `FilterDSPKernelAdapter`도 포함됩니다.

segments.source: `AUv3FilterDemoViewController` is the Audio Unit’s main view controller.
segments.ko: `AUv3FilterDemoViewController`는 Audio Unit의 메인 뷰 컨트롤러입니다.

segments.source: It adopts the [`AUAudioUnitFactory`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnitFactory) protocol and is responsible for creating new instances of your plug-in.
segments.ko: 이 클래스는 [`AUAudioUnitFactory`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnitFactory) protocol을 채택하며 플러그인의 새 인스턴스 생성을 담당합니다.

segments.source: You implement the protocol’s [`createAudioUnit(with:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnitFactory/createAudioUnit(with:)) factory method to return a new instance of `AUv3FilterDemo` when a host app requests it.
segments.ko: 호스트 앱의 요청 시 `AUv3FilterDemo`의 새 인스턴스를 반환하도록 protocol의 [`createAudioUnit(with:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnitFactory/createAudioUnit(with:)) factory 메서드를 구현합니다.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: To ensure glitch-free performance, your plug-in’s audio processing must occur in a real-time safe context.
segments.ko: ❗ **중요**: 글리치 없는 성능을 보장하려면 플러그인의 오디오 처리가 실시간 안전한 컨텍스트에서 이루어져야 합니다.

segments.source: Don’t allocate memory, perform file I/O, take locks, or interact with the Swift or Objective-C runtimes when rendering audio.
segments.ko: 오디오 렌더링 시 메모리를 할당하거나 파일 I/O를 수행하거나 잠금을 걸거나 Swift 또는 Objective-C 런타임과 상호작용해서는 안 됩니다.

segments.source: Add Custom Parameters to Your Audio Unit
segments.ko: 오디오 유닛에 사용자 지정 매개변수 추가

segments.source: In most Audio Units, you’ll provide one or more parameters to configure the audio processing.
segments.ko: 대부분의 Audio Unit에서는 오디오 처리를 구성하기 위해 하나 이상의 매개변수를 제공합니다.

segments.source: Your Audio Unit arranges its parameters into a tree structure, provided by an instance of [`AUParameterTree`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterTree).
segments.ko: 오디오 유닛은 [`AUParameterTree`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterTree) 인스턴스가 제공하는 트리 구조로 매개변수를 배치합니다.

segments.source: This object represents the root node of the plug-in’s tree of parameters and parameter groupings.
segments.ko: 이 객체는 플러그인 매개변수와 매개변수 그룹 트리의 루트 노드를 나타냅니다.

segments.source: `AUv3FilterDemo` has parameters to control the filter’s cutoff frequency and resonance.
segments.ko: `AUv3FilterDemo`에는 필터의 컷오프 주파수와 공진을 제어하는 매개변수가 있습니다.

segments.source: You create its parameters using a factory method on `AUParameterTree`.
segments.ko:
`AUParameterTree`의 factory 메서드를 사용해 매개변수를 생성합니다.
```swift
private enum AUv3FilterParam: AUParameterAddress {
    case cutoff, resonance
}

/// The parameter to control the cutoff frequency (12 Hz - 20 kHz).
var cutoffParam: AUParameter = {
    let parameter =
        AUParameterTree.createParameter(withIdentifier: "cutoff",
                                        name: "Cutoff",
                                        address: AUv3FilterParam.cutoff.rawValue,
                                        min: 12.0,
                                        max: 20_000.0,
                                        unit: .hertz,
                                        unitName: nil,
                                        flags: [.flag_IsReadable,
                                                .flag_IsWritable,
                                                .flag_CanRamp],
                                        valueStrings: nil,
                                        dependentParameters: nil)
    // Set default value
    parameter.value = 0.0

    return parameter
}()

/// The parameter to control the cutoff frequency's resonance (+/-20 dB).
var resonanceParam: AUParameter = {
    let parameter =
        AUParameterTree.createParameter(withIdentifier: "resonance",
                                        name: "Resonance",
                                        address: AUv3FilterParam.resonance.rawValue,
                                        min: -20.0,
                                        max: 20.0,
                                        unit: .decibels,
                                        unitName: nil,
                                        flags: [.flag_IsReadable,
                                                .flag_IsWritable,
                                                .flag_CanRamp],
                                        valueStrings: nil,
                                        dependentParameters: nil)
    // Set the default value.
    parameter.value = 20_000.0

    return parameter
}()
```

segments.source: The cutoff parameter defines a frequency range between 12 Hz and 20 kHz, and the resonance parameter defines a decibel range between -20 dB and 20 dB.
segments.ko: 컷오프 매개변수는 12 Hz에서 20 kHz 범위를 정의하고, 공진 매개변수는 -20 dB에서 20 dB 범위를 정의합니다.

segments.source: Each parameter is readable and writeable, and also supports ramping, which means you can modify its value over time.
segments.ko: 각 매개변수는 읽기 및 쓰기가 가능하며 램핑도 지원하므로 시간이 지남에 따라 값을 수정할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: You arrange the parameters into a tree by creating an `AUParameterTree` instance and setting them as the tree’s children.
segments.ko: `AUParameterTree` 인스턴스를 생성하고 이를 트리의 자식으로 설정하여 매개변수를 트리로 구성합니다.

segments.source:
```swift
// Create the audio unit's tree of parameters.
parameterTree = AUParameterTree.createTree(withChildren: [cutoffParam,
                                                          resonanceParam])
```
segments.ko:
```swift

parameterTree = AUParameterTree.createTree(withChildren: [cutoffParam,
                                                          resonanceParam])
```

segments.source: Next, you bind handlers to the parameter tree’s readable and writeable values by installing closures for its [`implementorValueObserver`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterNode/implementorValueObserver), [`implementorValueProvider`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterNode/implementorValueProvider), and [`implementorStringFromValueCallback`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterNode/implementorStringFromValueCallback) properties.
segments.ko: Next, you bind handlers to the parameter tree’s readable and writeable values by installing closures for its [`implementorValueObserver`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterNode/implementorValueObserver), [`implementorValueProvider`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterNode/implementorValueProvider), and [`implementorStringFromValueCallback`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUParameterNode/implementorStringFromValueCallback) properties.

segments.source: These closures delegate to the filter adapter instance, which in turn communicates with the underlying DSP logic.
segments.ko: 이러한 클로저는 filter adapter 인스턴스로 위임되며, 이는 다시 하위 DSP 로직과 통신합니다.

segments.source: Connect the Parameters to Your User Interface
segments.ko: 매개변수를 사용자 인터페이스에 연결

segments.source: The sample app’s iOS and macOS targets each provide a platform-specific user interface.
segments.ko: 샘플 앱의 iOS 및 macOS 대상은 각각 플랫폼별 사용자 인터페이스를 제공합니다.

segments.source: You use a shared view controller called `AUv3FilterDemoViewController` to coordinate the communication between the user interface and the Audio Unit.
segments.ko: 사용자 인터페이스와 Audio Unit 간 통신을 조정하기 위해 `AUv3FilterDemoViewController`라는 공유 뷰 컨트롤러를 사용합니다.

segments.source: Connect your user interface to the Audio Unit’s parameters in the `connectViewToAU()` method.
segments.ko: `connectViewToAU()` 메서드에서 사용자 인터페이스를 Audio Unit의 매개변수에 연결합니다.

segments.source: As shown above, in the `connectViewToAU()` method, you find the Audio Unit’s parameter tree and retrieve its cutoff and resonance parameters.
segments.ko: 위의 코드에서처럼 `connectViewToAU()` 메서드에서는 Audio Unit의 매개변수 트리를 찾아 cutoff 및 resonance 매개변수를 검색합니다.

segments.source: You also add an observer closure to update the user interface as the plug-in’s parameter values change.
segments.ko: 플러그인 매개변수 값이 변경될 때 사용자 인터페이스를 업데이트하도록 옵저버 클로저도 추가합니다.

segments.source: Add Factory Presets
segments.ko: 팩토리 프리셋 추가

segments.source: Most audio plug-ins provide a collection of preset values known as *factory presets*.
segments.ko: 대부분의 오디오 플러그인에는 *factory presets*이라고 하는 미리 정의된 값의 집합이 있습니다.

segments.source: A factory preset is a preconfigured arrangement of the plug-in’s parameter values that provide a useful starting point for further customization.
segments.ko: 팩토리 프리셋은 플러그인의 매개변수 값을 미리 구성한 값으로, 추가 사용자 지정 작업을 위한 유용한 시작점을 제공합니다.

segments.source: A host app presents these presets in its user interface so the user can select them.
segments.ko: 호스트 앱은 이러한 프리셋을 사용자 인터페이스에 표시하여 사용자가 선택할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.source: The following code example shows how to define the factory presets and their associated values.
segments.ko: 다음 코드 예시는 팩토리 프리셋과 해당 연결 값을 정의하는 방법을 보여줍니다.

segments.source:
```swift
public override var factoryPresets: [AUAudioUnitPreset] {
    return [
        AUAudioUnitPreset(number: 0, name: "Prominent"),
        AUAudioUnitPreset(number: 1, name: "Bright"),
        AUAudioUnitPreset(number: 2, name: "Warm")
    ]
}

private let factoryPresetValues:[(cutoff: AUValue, resonance: AUValue)] = [
    (2500.0, 5.0),    // "Prominent"
    (14_000.0, 12.0), // "Bright"
    (384.0, -3.0)     // "Warm"
]
```

segments.source: Support User Presets
segments.ko: 사용자 프리셋 지원

segments.source: Factory presets provide a useful starting point for further user customization, but users also want the ability to save their changes and create their own custom presets.
segments.ko: 팩토리 프리셋은 추가 사용자 지정의 유용한 시작점을 제공하지만, 사용자는 변경 사항을 저장하고 자신만의 사용자 프리셋을 만들 수 있어야 합니다.

segments.source: `AUAudioUnit` provides built-in support for user presets.
segments.ko: `AUAudioUnit`은(는) 사용자 프리셋에 대한 기본 지원을 제공합니다.

segments.source: To enable this support in your Audio Unit, override the [`supportsUserPresets`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/supportsUserPresets) property to return `true`.
segments.ko: 이 지원을 Audio Unit에서 사용하려면 [`supportsUserPresets`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/supportsUserPresets) 속성을 재정의하여 `true`를 반환하도록 합니다.

segments.source: Opting in to support for user presets automatically enables your Audio Unit to load, save, and delete user presets.
segments.ko: 사용자 프리셋 지원을 활성화하면 Audio Unit이 사용자 프리셋을 자동으로 로드하고 저장 및 삭제할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The default implementation of the [`userPresets`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/userPresets), [`saveUserPreset(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/saveUserPreset(_:)), and [`deleteUserPreset(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/deleteUserPreset(_:)) API reads from and writes to an internal store, but you’re free to override this property and methods if you want to directly manage the persistence behavior.
segments.ko: [`userPresets`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/userPresets), [`saveUserPreset(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/saveUserPreset(_:)), [`deleteUserPreset(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/deleteUserPreset(_:)) API의 기본 구현은 내부 저장소에서 읽기와 쓰기를 수행하지만, 지속성 동작을 직접 관리하려는 경우 이 속성과 메서드를 재정의할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: For example, you can override the default behavior to persist user presets to an iCloud container or some other remote location.
segments.ko: 예를 들어, 기본 동작을 재정의하여 사용자 프리셋을 iCloud 컨테이너 또는 다른 원격 위치에 직접 영속화할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Select Factory and User Presets
segments.ko: 팩토리 및 사용자 프리셋 선택

segments.source: A host app selects a factory or user preset by setting the plug-in’s `currentPreset` property.
segments.ko: 호스트 앱은 플러그인의 `currentPreset` 속성을 설정하여 팩토리 또는 사용자 프리셋을 선택합니다.

segments.source: You override this property and take the appropriate action depending on the preset type selected.
segments.ko: 이 속성을 재정의하고 선택한 프리셋 유형에 따라 적절한 동작을 수행합니다.

segments.source: If the user selected a factory preset (a preset `number` greater than `0`), look up its associated values and set the parameter values accordingly.
segments.ko: 사용자가 팩토리 프리셋(프리셋 `number`가 `0`보다 큰 값)을 선택한 경우, 해당 값 집합을 조회하여 매개변수 값을 그에 맞게 설정합니다.

segments.source: If the user selected a user preset (a preset `number` less than `0`), restore the preset’s parameter state by calling the [`presetState(for:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/presetState(for:)) method and setting the returned data as the [`fullStateForDocument`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/fullStateForDocument) property.
segments.ko: If the user selected a user preset (a preset `number` less than `0`), restore the preset’s parameter state by calling the [`presetState(for:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/presetState(for:)) method and setting the returned data as the [`fullStateForDocument`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AUAudioUnit/fullStateForDocument) property.

segments.source: Package Your Plug in to Run in Process
segments.ko: Package Your Plug in to Run in Process

segments.source: Like all App Extensions, AUv3 plug-ins run *out-of-process* by default, which means the extension runs in a separate process from the host app, and all communication between the two occurs over interprocess communication (IPC).
segments.ko: Like all App Extensions, AUv3 plug-ins run *out-of-process* by default, which means the extension runs in a separate process from the host app, and all communication between the two occurs over interprocess communication (IPC).

segments.source: This model provides increased security and stability for the host app.
segments.ko: This model provides increased security and stability for the host app.

segments.source: For example, if an AUv3 plug-in crashes, the host app won’t crash.
segments.ko: For example, if an AUv3 plug-in crashes, the host app won’t crash.

segments.source: However, the IPC communication adds a small amount of overhead to each render cycle, which may be unacceptable depending on the needs of a given application.
segments.ko: However, the IPC communication adds a small amount of overhead to each render cycle, which may be unacceptable depending on the needs of a given application.

segments.source: In macOS only, you can package your plug-in to run *in-process*, which eliminates the IPC communication as your Audio Unit runs as part of the host’s process.
segments.ko: In macOS only, you can package your plug-in to run *in-process*, which eliminates the IPC communication as your Audio Unit runs as part of the host’s process.

segments.source: Running an in-process plug-in requires an agreement between the host and the Audio Unit.
segments.ko: Running an in-process plug-in requires an agreement between the host and the Audio Unit.

segments.source: The host requests in-process instantiation by passing the [`loadInProcess`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AudioComponentInstantiationOptions/loadInProcess) option during the plug-in’s creation, and you need to package your Audio Unit as described and shown below.
segments.ko: The host requests in-process instantiation by passing the [`loadInProcess`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AudioToolbox/AudioComponentInstantiationOptions/loadInProcess) option during the plug-in’s creation, and you need to package your Audio Unit as described and shown below.

segments.source: Your extension’s main binary can’t be dynamically loaded into another app, which means all executable code needs to reside in a separate framework bundle.
segments.ko: Your extension’s main binary can’t be dynamically loaded into another app, which means all executable code needs to reside in a separate framework bundle.

segments.source: However, the extension target still needs to contain at least one source file for the extension binary to be created, properly loaded, and linked with the framework bundle.
segments.ko: However, the extension target still needs to contain at least one source file for the extension binary to be created, properly loaded, and linked with the framework bundle.

segments.source: To ensure the extension is created, add some unused placeholder code in your extension target, like that found in `AUv3FilterExtension.swift`.
segments.ko: To ensure the extension is created, add some unused placeholder code in your extension target, like that found in `AUv3FilterExtension.swift`.

segments.source: The macOS sample packages all of the Audio Unit’s code into the `AUv3FilterFramework` target.
segments.ko: The macOS sample packages all of the Audio Unit’s code into the `AUv3FilterFramework` target.

segments.source: You indicate that the extension’s code exists in a separate bundle by adding an `AudioComponentBundle` extension attribute to the target’s `Info.plist` file.
segments.ko: You indicate that the extension’s code exists in a separate bundle by adding an `AudioComponentBundle` extension attribute to the target’s `Info.plist` file.

segments.source:
```None
<key>NSExtension</key>
<dict>
    <key>NSExtensionAttributes</key>
    <dict>
        <key>AudioComponentBundle</key>
        <string>com.example.apple-samplecode.AUv3FilterFramework</string>
        ...
    </dict>
    ...
</dict>
```

segments.source: If you’re using a xib or Storyboard for your user interface, override your view controller’s [`init(nibName:bundle:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSViewController/init(nibName:bundle:)) initializer and pass the framework bundle to the superclass initializer.
segments.ko: If you’re using a xib or Storyboard for your user interface, override your view controller’s [`init(nibName:bundle:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSViewController/init(nibName:bundle:)) initializer and pass the framework bundle to the superclass initializer.

segments.source: This ensures your user interface properly loads when the system requests your Audio Unit extension.
segments.ko: This ensures your user interface properly loads when the system requests your Audio Unit extension.

segments.source: Finally, in the extension’s `Info.plist` file, set the Audio Unit’s factory object, `AUv3FilterDemoViewController`, as the extension’s principal class.
segments.ko: Finally, in the extension’s `Info.plist` file, set the Audio Unit’s factory object, `AUv3FilterDemoViewController`, as the extension’s principal class.

```None
<key>NSExtension</key>
<dict>
    <key>NSExtensionPrincipalClass</key>
    <string>AUv3FilterFramework.AUv3FilterDemoViewController</string>
    ...
</dict>
```
